excerpt: Internal transparency: We will share final, unredacted Risk Reports with Anthropic's regular-clearance staff.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to sharing complete, unredacted Risk Reports internally with regular-clearance staff.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Transparency: We will share summaries of Capability Reports and Safeguards Reports with Anthropic's regular-clearance staff, redacting any highly-sensitive information.

excerpt: Noncompliance reporting: We will maintain a process for Anthropic staff to submit anonymous or identified reports regarding potential noncompliance with this policy.
paraphrase: Anthropic will maintain a reporting process, allowing anonymous or identified submissions, for potential policy noncompliance.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Noncompliance: We will maintain a process through which Anthropic staff may anonymously notify the Responsible Scaling Officer of any potential instances of noncompliance with this policy.

excerpt: Staff will have more than one option for who receives these reports, including the RSO, and at least one executive who does not report to the RSO.
paraphrase: Staff can choose among multiple report recipients, including the RSO and an executive independent of the RSO.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: We will also establish a policy governing noncompliance reporting, which will (1) protect reporters from retaliation and (2) set forth a mechanism for escalating reports to one or more members of the Board of Directors in cases where the report relates to conduct of the Responsible Scaling Officer.

excerpt: When we receive a report, we will promptly investigate, take appropriate and proportional corrective action if it is substantiated, and document the report and our findings.
paraphrase: Upon receiving a report, Anthropic will investigate promptly, act proportionally if substantiated, and document the outcome.
prior_counterpart_excerpt: Further, we will track and investigate any reported or otherwise identified potential instances of noncompliance with this policy.

excerpt: We will provide quarterly updates to the Board regarding reports of potential noncompliance, whether substantiated or not.

prior_counterpart_excerpt: The Responsible Scaling Officer will regularly update the Board of Directors on substantial cases of noncompliance and overall trends.

excerpt: If we determine that a report is (1) substantiated and (2) involves a material safety risk, we will promptly notify the Board and we may provide public notice of the same.
